directories.description: The Personal Health Wallet IG's IG Publisher AST, ingested although the IG source is not. Read from the branch family cat/fhir-harness/fhir-ast/ on litlfred/smart-trust-phw, one branch per IG package id; this IG's branch is cat/fhir-harness/fhir-ast/smart.who.int.trust-phw. Restored by fhir-harness/scripts/ig-cache.sh; absent from the checkout.

The artefact index for smart-trust-phw. fhir-harness's `ig-index:build` writes `index.json`, `menu.json`, `releases.json` and `package.tgz` at publish from the IG's AST; they are not committed. `ig-identity.json` and the README are.
directories.readOnlyBasis: Generated: fhir-harness's `ig-index:build` writes this index at publish from the IG's AST. A hand edit changes what this repository claims upstream published; `check:materialized-fixity` catches one.

directories.description: How this IG realises the document kinds of the layers it needs: `dak.coverage.smart-trust-phw.json`, the DAK view of `fhir-artifact-index/`, which places each artefact in one of the ten DAK components by its FHIR resource type and lists what no rule places. Generated at publish by `bun run cat smart-base:document-kinds` (`gen-document-kinds.ts`), after the index it reads, and not committed.

The artefact pages of smart-trust-phw's IG site, generated at publish from `fhir-artifact-index/index.json` by `smart-trust-phw:pages` (`fhir-harness/scripts/gen-ig-pages.ts`) and built under `/smart-trust-phw/` in the IG's menu. Never authored or committed.

L1 normative specification snapshots materialized for smart-trust-phw: IHE ITI Privacy Consent on FHIR (PCF) 1.1.0 (`ihe-iti-pcf-1-1-0`, CC BY 4.0) and IHE ITI Verifiable Health Links (VHL) 1.0.0-comment (`ihe-iti-vhl-1-0-0-comment`, CC BY 4.0). Every knowledge-graph reference to these IHE specifications resolves through here, and `check:materialized-fixity` verifies their SHA-256 digests against `catalogue/`.

Qualified Dublin Core (`folio-dublin-core/v1`) and catalogue node (`folio-catalogue-node/v1`) records for two kinds of item: the IHE ITI specifications materialized in `library/` (PCF 1.1.0 and VHL 1.0.0-comment), and every work the IG cites that is not ingested, as a `referenced` item whose record is the IG's bibliography entry, keyed by the citation's `#ref-<slug>`. A capture of a cited work, when one exists, is in the repository's `uploads/` data store, which is not part of the KG. `bun run cat check:catalogue` and `bun run cat check:materialized-fixity` verify every node, metadataRef, libraryId, localPath and SHA-256 digest.
directories.readOnlyBasis: Records of IHE ITI supplements (`profiles.ihe.net`), whose SHA-256 digests `check:materialized-fixity` verifies against `library/`, and the IG's bibliography records for the works it cites: change a citation's record here, never on a page.

directories.description: The guide's business processes PHW.A to PHW.K (BPMN 2.0), the IG source the IG Publisher renders; the processes viewer draws them for this layer. Each is drawn to input/images/PHW.<id>.svg by tools/render-bpmn/render_bpmn.ts (bootstrap-tools' renderer); CI fails when a drawing is stale. Never edit a drawing: change the BPMN.

This layer's generators, each with a --check that CI runs: render-bpmn draws input/business-processes/*.bpmn into input/images/; personas writes input/pagecontent/personas.md from scenarios/. The site is published by the harness's stage-local.ts --fresh.

The roles the lanes of the business processes name (roles.json, each pointing to its ActorDefinition in input/fsh/actors/actors.fsh where one exists), and example people and systems that play them (actors/, each person with a meta.persona). tools/personas/gen_personas.ts writes the Generic Personas page from them. Every person is fictional.
